info.title: Agri Trace API

post.description: Sets an HttpOnly session selector and a refresh cookie named agritrace_refresh_<sessionId>. Send both cookies on refresh/logout. Refresh responses only update their own family cookie.
post.summary: Sign in and revoke the previous browser session

post.description: Without session cookies this is a successful no-op. With cookies, clears only this family cookie. The selector is intentionally not changed by refresh/logout, so a late response cannot replace or clear a newer login.
post.summary: Revoke all tokens in the selected session family

401.description: Invalid JWT or inactive user, organization or session

post.description: Requires the selector and its HttpOnly family cookie. A concurrent rotation returns 409 without clearing cookies; retry after the winning response updates the cookie.

401.description: Missing, expired, revoked or replayed session; JWTs without sid are rejected

409.description: Concurrent rotation within 5 seconds; retry with the current cookie

501.description: Account registration is disabled; Admin provisions accounts.
